{{Quote|If I get an execution order, I always sign it. Better a wrong man dead than a traitor left alive, right?|Tyrak|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Tyrak''', codename '''Golden''' by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who held the rank of a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]] and [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sixty-third Armored Infantry Division]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
Tyrak was responsible for demise of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Spar]], signing the execution order without even reading it. The sole survivor [[Akaavi Spar]] vowed to track him down and exact her revenge. In [[3642 BBY]], Tyrak was working with the [[Balmorran resistance|resistance]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire's]] interests and planning to defect. He was operating as a double-agent, and supplied information to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] about [[Project Nebula]] while it was in Imperial hands. His contact in the Republic base was [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Numen Brock]]. At some point, he left an information package about a Project Nebula's shipment's location in [[Okara Droid Factory]] for the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound]] to retrieve. When his cover was blown, he requested extraction from the Nebula research base, but it was denied to him until the Nebula weapons were fully retrieved. He accompanied Voidhound to the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]], where he provided access codes to the weapon, before being confronted by Akaavi Spar, who demanded her revenge.<ref name="TOR" />
